page.layout: One page with an index heading across the top. Below it, two columns of index entries. The left column runs down to the bottom edge of the scan. The right column is cut off after "Demosthenes argutus ab Æschine" (the rest is blank in this part). No margins, no page number, no catchword.; Two columns of an alphabetical index, set in small italic type. Left column: its lower end at the bottom left, a few lines. Right column: the upper part of a column, running down the right side, then the foot of the page with the signature "Z 3" at the bottom centre.

page.notes: Greek words in the Cleon, Cleodemus, Daui and Danaidum entries are not legible enough to copy with confidence; the first two Cleon Greek words and the Daui Greek are marked illegible. The Digma entry's Greek and the Ψήφισμα accent are copied as seen. The "David" page reference is cut off at the bottom edge; only the visible digits are given. The right column ends at the Demosthenes entry; the remainder of that column is absent from this part. The Greek words in the entries for Demosthenes are only approximately read and are marked [?]. The first line of the left-column fragment is partly obscured, so "Dania" is uncertain.
